Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Reference Pose Weight Threshold
Fields.Description: Below this total weight, the reference pose is blended in to fill the gap (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Blend Parameter
Fields.Description: Where the blend is between the children's Weight values. Usually bound to a variable, such as a movement speed.

Fields.Name: Min Cyclic Blend Parameter
Fields.Description: The lowest blend parameter value, when the blend is cyclic.

Fields.Name: Max Cyclic Blend Parameter
Fields.Description: The highest blend parameter value, when the blend is cyclic: it wraps to the min.

Fields.Name: Index Of Sync Master Child
Fields.Description: The child the others are synced to. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Blender Flags
Fields.Description: Blend options: sync, smooth generator weights, don't deactivate children with zero weight, parametric blend, cyclic parametric blend, force dense pose, blend the motion of additive animations, velocity synchronization.

Fields.Name: Subtract Last Child
Fields.Description: Whether the last child's pose is subtracted from the blend (an additive blend).

Fields.Name: Children
Fields.Description: The generators blended, each with its own weight and bone weights.
